last_result.content:
## 7.1 Ownership of Work Product

"Work Product" means all deliverables, software, source code, model architectures, trained
model weights and parameters, feature definitions, notebooks, reports, and documentation
that Consultant creates in the course of performing the Services. All Work Product, and all
intellectual property rights in the Work Product, are and will remain the exclusive property
of Consultant. Subject to Client's payment of all amounts due, Consultant grants Client a
non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable license to use and execute the
Deliverables solely for Client's internal business purposes. Client will not distribute,
resell, host for, or otherwise make the Deliverables available to any third party, and will
not modify the Deliverables or prepare derivative works of them except through Services
performed by Consultant.

action.title: Ownership of Work Product
action.analysis: The provision assigns ownership of all work product, including intellectual property rights, to the consultant (DataCraft). This is contrary to the client's interest and the playbook which emphasizes retaining ownership or at least a broader license to the work product.
action.recommendation: Negotiate for ownership of the work product to be assigned to Harvest Grocery Holdings, LLC or at minimum, secure a more permissive license.

## 4 Harvest Data

Harvest data supplied for a project may be used solely to perform that project. A supplier
may not use Harvest data, or features, embeddings, statistics, benchmarks, or other data
derived from it, to develop, train, tune, or benchmark models, products, or services for any
other customer, whether or not the data is aggregated, de-identified, or anonymized. Data
and derived data must be deleted or returned within thirty days after the project ends,
subject only to routine backup retention. Any supplier right to reuse Harvest data is a
non-negotiable departure. Escalate.

last_result.content:
## 6.1 Client Data

Client will provide thirty-six (36) months of store-level point-of-sale transaction records,
promotion calendars, inventory positions, and product master data (collectively, "Client
Data") through a secure transfer mechanism within ten (10) business days after kickoff.
Client is responsible for obtaining all rights and permissions necessary for Consultant to
receive and use the Client Data as contemplated by this Statement of Work.

action.title: Restriction on Data Reuse
action.analysis: The playbook explicitly states that Harvest data cannot be reused by the supplier for any other customer. However, there is no explicit prohibition on data reuse in the PSA or SOW. This omission could lead to potential misuse of Harvest's data.
action.recommendation: Escalate this issue as it is a non-negotiable requirement according to the playbook.

quotes.text: Harvest data supplied for a project may be used solely to perform that project. A supplier may not use Harvest data, or features, embeddings, statistics, benchmarks, or other data derived from it, to develop, train, tune, or benchmark models, products, or services for any other customer, whether or not the data is aggregated, de-identified, or anonymized.

action.summary: Reviewed the Professional Services Agreement and Statement of Work against the client's playbook. Identified two critical issues: (1) Ownership of Work Product, where we proposed a redline to ensure Harvest retains ownership and a broad license to the deliverables, and (2) Restriction on Data Reuse, which was escalated as it is a non-negotiable requirement according to the playbook. All issues and redlines have been addressed and submitted.
